name: Daughter of Putiel
title: Wife of Eleazar and mother of Phinehas
summary: The daughter of Putiel was married to Eleazar, Aaron's son, and became the mother of Phinehas, who continued the priestly service in Aaron's line.

keyEvents.title: Mother of Phinehas
keyEvents.description: Eleazar, Aaron's son, took one of Putiel's daughters as his wife, and she bore him Phinehas.
